### "Name Sticker" Goblin

{2}{R} · Creature — Goblin Guest · common · 2/2

> When this creature enters from anywhere other than a graveyard or exile, if it's on the battlefield and you control 9 or fewer creatures named "Name Sticker" Goblin, roll a 20-sided die.  
> 1-6 | Add {R}{R}{R}{R}.  
> 7-14 | Add {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.  
> 15-20 | Add {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.

**Status:** scripted · **tests naming it:** LsvBatch2c2Tests

**Engine pieces:** `AddMana` — "Add {C}" — or Gardenize's "{G} for each charge counter", counted as it resolves.; `AtLeast` — Eye of Jace: "if there are seven or more cards in your graveyard".; `Both` — Sylvia Tilly: "you may pay {1} and exile a card from your graveyard" — asked only when…; `Count` — A number in rules text, counted at resolution. Counting goes through Ref, so "creatures…; `If` — "If [condition], [effects]" — the effects run in order with this ability's context.; `Matches` — "If [something] is [filter]" — any object the Ref names matches. Prophesied End: "if it…; `Not` — The opposite of a condition — "isn't", "wasn't", "unless".; `Ref` — Who or what an effect acts on, resolved against the context at resolution: a referent…; `RollDie` — "Name Sticker" Goblin: "roll a 20-sided die. 1-6 | Add {R}{R}{R}{R}. 7-14 | … 15-20 | …"…

```csharp
["\"Name Sticker\" Goblin"] =
[
	When(
		TriggerEvent.SelfEnters with
		{
			NotFrom = [ZoneType.Graveyard, ZoneType.Exile],
		},
		[],
		new RollDie(
			20,
			[
				new(1, 6, [new AddMana(ManaColor.Red, 4)]),
				new(7, 14, [new AddMana(ManaColor.Red, 5)]),
				new(15, 20, [new AddMana(ManaColor.Red, 6)]),
			]
		)
	) with
	{
		// "if it's on the battlefield and you control 9 or fewer creatures named …" — a
		// permanent now: Ref.Source would read it as it last was once it is gone
		If = new Both(
			new Matches(Ref.Permanents(Is.Source), Is.AnyCard),
			new Not(
				new AtLeast(
					Count.NumberOf(
						Ref.Permanents(
							Is.Creature & Is.Yours & Is.Named("\"Name Sticker\" Goblin")
						)
					),
					10
				)
			)
		),
	},
],
```

Counting goes through Ref, so "creatures…; `DealDamage` — "[Source] deals N damage to …" — through Deal, so lifelink and deathtouch apply.; `ManaCost` — A printed mana cost, parsed from Scryfall's "{2}{W/U}{X}" notation.; `Matches` — "If [something] is [filter]" — any object the Ref names matches. [
	// Boast: "Activate only if this creature attacked this turn and only once each turn." The sacrificed
	// permanent is the ability's event card, its mana value read as it last was.
	new ActivatedAbilityComponent(
		ManaCost.None,

			),
		]
	)
	{

		Targets = [TargetSpec.AnyTarget()],
		OnlyIf = new Matches(Ref.Source, Is.AttackedThisTurn),
		OncePerTurn = true,
	},
],

**Engine pieces:** `Count` — A number in rules text, counted at resolution. Counting goes through Ref, so "creatures…; `DamageFrom` — "[A] deals damage equal to its power (or loyalty) to [B]" - the source is A, not the…; `Ref` — Who or what an effect acts on, resolved against the context at resolution: a referent…; `StaticEffectComponent` — A static ability that changes characteristics while its source is on the battlefield —…; `TargetSpec` — What one "target" word allows: a zone, a filter (which objects there), and the targeting…; `Trigger` — "When/Whenever [something happens]" — the kind of event, then which of its subjects…

```csharp

[
	new StaticEffectComponent(Is.Source)
	{
		Power = Count.CardTypesAmong(Ref.All(ZoneType.Graveyard)),
		Toughness = Count.CardTypesAmong(Ref.All(ZoneType.Graveyard)),
	},
	// "this creature or another Lhurgoyf creature you control" — "that creature deals"
	When(
		new Trigger(EventKind.Entered)
		{
			Subject = Is.Creature & Is.Yours & (Is.Source | Is.Subtype("Lhurgoyf")),
		},
		[TargetSpec.AnyTarget()],
		new DamageFrom(Ref.EventCard, Ref.Target(), Count.PowerOf(Ref.EventCard))
	),
],
```
